headline: Falcons WR Zachariah Branch charges dropped, attorney says
description: Georgia state prosecutors have dismissed a pair of misdemeanor charges against Falcons rookie wide receiver Zachariah Branch stemming from an arrest that occurred days before the NFL draft, his attorney told ESPN.
